comment: Prof Harrison was the way to go for strategic management! I added the class at the beginning of the semester and didn't really have many expectations, but I ended up really enjoying his class. He gives students ample opportunities to succeed and is one of the most caring professors I've had. There is a lot of homework, but he always gives feedback.

Professor Harrison is one of my favorite professor's I've had. He genuinely cares about his students' well being and success, and gives really great feedback on written assignments/projects. There are a LOT of individual and group writing assignments, so if you don't like writing, I wouldn't take this class. But love Prof Harrison!!!

Will act like you just invented the cure to cancer every time you contribute in class. Projects are strong, but they're not bad. On the scale of fish to birds, the class isn't birds, but it IS closer to birds than fish for sure. Harrison is a good dude, reminds me of one of my boys from high school.
